## Result: hypothesis + numbers

### Final hypothesis (for submission, English)

> **In the NLSY79 cohort, increased time preference — proxied by more impatient savings behavior in 1989 (taking money out of savings rather than putting money in) — is associated with slightly higher BMI, but the association is small and cross-sectional, not causal.** Specifically, one step toward more impatient savings behavior (put-in → no-change → took-out) is **associated with Δ0.16 BMI units (95% CI 0.002–0.322, p=0.047)** in an OLS model adjusting for age, sex, race, 1989 family income and 1985 family wealth (n=5,665). Raw group means (BMI from 1989 weight / 1985 height): put-in 24.69 (n=2,713) < no-change 25.26 (n=1,509) ≈ took-out 25.25 (n=2,901) < no-savings 25.45 (n=3,044); took-out vs put-in difference 0.56 (unadjusted) / 0.41 (adjusted, p=0.018). Because the design is cross-sectional and savings behavior is entangled with income and wealth, this should be read as a weak positive association between impatience and weight, not evidence that impatience leads to higher BMI.

### Key numbers

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| **Primary OLS** BMI_1989 ~ TP(−1/0/+1) + age + sex + race + logInc89 + wealth85 (HC1) | β=**0.162** [0.002, 0.322], t=1.98, **p=0.048**, n=5,665, R²=0.030 |
| Group means (complete cases) | put_in 24.60 (n=2,194) / no_change 25.02 (n=1,152) / took_out 25.01 (n=2,319) |
| t-test took-out vs put-in (adj. sample) | diff **0.41**, t=−2.36, **p=0.018** |
| ANOVA 3-group | F=3.52, p=0.030 |
| **4-group ANOVA incl. no_savings** (full BMI+SVC sample, n=10,167) | F=**7.25, p=7.4e-05**; means 24.69 / 25.26 / 25.25 / 25.45 — gradient partly preserved: put-in lowest, no-savings highest, but took-out ≈ no-change |
| Adjusted 4-group OLS (dummies, n=7,878) | took_out vs put_in β=0.325 [−0.004, 0.655], p=0.053 |
| Robustness: BMI 1992 (n=4,686) | β=**0.235** [0.079, 0.392], **p=0.003** |
| Robustness: winzorized weight p99.5 (n=5,665) | β=0.200 [0.073, 0.326], p=0.002 |
| Robustness: continuous net flow, log1p(SIN)−log1p(SOUT) (n=4,513) | β=0.022 per log-unit [−0.002, 0.046], p=0.071 (weakest) |
| Correlations (TP vs BMI_1989) | Pearson r=0.032 (p=0.017); Spearman ρ=0.042 (p=0.002) |

Интерпретация: направление (более нетерпеливое сберегательное поведение → выше BMI) **консистентно во всех спецификациях**, статистически значимо в primary и в robustness по BMI-1992/winzor, но **малое по величине** (~0.2–0.5 BMI units, <2% SD BMI). Continuous-прокси (размер потока) эффект даёт слабее — говорит в пользу того, что проксирует именно направление (выбор «сейчас vs потом»), а не размер.

### Workflow (для payload.workflow)

1. Load NLSY79 (12,686 × 61, 0 dup IDs). **Weight 1989/1992 interpreted as POUNDS despite metadata saying kg** — justification: median 158, sex split M=175/F=135 (implausible as kg), implied BMI from 1989W/1985H mean 25.2/median 24.3 (vs 55.5 if kg); height 1985 in inches (M=70″/F=64.2″). Height 1981 (400–611) found in inconsistent units (implied BMI mean 36.9, sex gap 0.6″) and **excluded**.
2. BMI = weight_1989(lb→kg) / (height_1985(in→m))²; same-interview-year weight as the savings behavior (1989); adult height stable over 1985→1989.
3. Time-preference proxy: 1989 savings-flow direction (put-in=−1, no-change=0, took-out=+1); no-savings (n=3,200) excluded from primary (inability to save ≠ impatience), kept as a 4th category in robustness.
4. Missing: listwise deletion (analysis n: 10,167 → 5,665 with covariates); income/wealth log+winzor p99.5 (top-codes 1.06M/8.19M/9.99M); weight winzor p99.5 sensitivity (11 obs >400 lb).
5. Primary OLS with HC1 SE + group comparisons; robustness: 4-group ANOVA, BMI 1992, winzorized weight, continuous net flow, correlations.

### Limitations
- Cross-sectional: **association, not causation**; reverse causality plausible (BMI → income/wealth → savings).
- Savings 1989 — один 4-летний поток; прокси time preference шумный (income shocks, семья, liquidity).
- Selection: savings-выборка (10,573/12,686) смещена в более состоятельные (income put-in $67.9k vs no-savings $22.7k); listwise attrition до 5,665.
- Unit-интерпретация веса (lb) — data-driven допущение, contradicts metadata.
- 4-group gradient не монотонен: took-out ≈ no-change; эффект несёт contrast put-in vs остальных.
